Senses.Explanation: Filling ditches and blocking ravines depicts total, indiscriminate saturation: snow, treasure, or a failed placement leaves every hollow packed with no gap for discrimination. Asked where an answer that opens the eyes and blinds lands, Zhongyuan says it fills ditches and blocks ravines. Mi’an’s snow verse says the snow fills ditches and blocks ravines so that no one can distinguish them. Fachang says the undivided expanse fills ditches and blocks ravines while no one understands it. Yunmen Xiansheng says treasures fill ditches and block ravines after the world is made into a single eye and nostril.

Occurrences.Kwic: 麼生？師云：手中拂三十錢買來底。進云：謝師答話。師云：且道劫雲之前是何景象？進云：今朝不用重追究，曾向湖南佛國來。師云：三十棒自領出去。乃云：從本無生，誰曰有生？無生緣生，緣生無生，達此生理，不妨生生。所以云：生生謂之道，萬古碧潭光皎皎，四方八面絕遮攔，曰聖曰凡俱不了。慈明和尚云：手鑠黃河乾，脚蹋須彌倒，天堂并地獄，皆繇心所造。卓拄杖，云：若真獅子兒，不向那邊討。知非首座請上堂。博山久不上堂，諸人生出幾多妄想，如渴鹿趂陽𦦨，有甚了期？何不向自己脚跟下薦取？諸昆仲！若欲向自己脚跟下薦取，最先要看破依正二報、四生六道，悉從因緣生，還從因緣滅。釋迦老子四十九年橫說竪說總是緣生法，豈不見報化非真佛，亦無說法者？汝等莫見博山恁麼道便向法身邊住著？殊不知法身邊沾黏一絲毫不得，若黏著纖毫，便如猢猻著鎻不得，自繇伶俐漢如香象渡河截流而過，豈不俊哉？茲因知非首座六十大誕設齋供眾，仍請博山為大眾說法，且道今日博山是因齋慶讚耶？慰諸人妄想耶？良久，云：靈芝和雨秀，菡萏帶風香。卓拄杖，下座。張二水相國請上堂，首座問：壁上高僧，呼著即應。今日相國臨筵，當機如何指的？師云：鳥啼菴後竹。進云：恁麼則撩天索價非思議，衣裏明珠覿面呈。師云：雲起面前山。進云：經綸妙手元非借，推轉吾宗大法輪。師云：如天普葢，似地普擎。僧問：承聞和尚有言：虗而靈，寂

Senses.Explanation: Literally 'to speak horizontally and vertically,' the expression means to range through a subject from every angle. Huangbo Xiyun says that Niutou did so yet still did not know the pivotal point beyond. Yunmen Wenyan applies it to the scriptures and contrasts their range with a needle-point measure. Chijue Daochong and Wuyi Yuanlai use it for the Buddha's forty-nine years of teaching, in contexts stressing that extensive speech remains conditioned or fails to reach the matter itself. Yu'an Zhiji's verse instead foregrounds the phrase's expansive, blazing energy. The expression therefore marks breadth and freedom of speech; its adequacy is judged by the surrounding sentence.

Senses.Explanation: To draw a prison on the ground: to make a confining boundary and then behave as though it binds you. Sanshan Denglai's authored memorial denies that a completed ninety-day retreat need be such a prison. Zhongfeng Mingben applies the image to a fixed hundred-and-twenty-day period, and Miyun Yuanwu calls a hundred-day retreat just such a boundary while saying its point is clarity. Tianyin Yuanxiu asks why anyone who has broken through would establish limits and draw this prison. In Poshan Haiming's record, an unnamed monk claims to have trampled through it and Poshan tests the claim. Feiyin Tongrong uses the image in his own retreat-opening address and immediately calls for turning around and jumping free.
Senses.Note: The drawn line has no physical bars; confinement comes from accepting a fixed period, conceptual limit, or self-made enclosure as binding.

Occurrences.Kwic: 大慧忌日，拈香云：口似血盆呵佛祖，牙如劍樹罵諸方，而今死入阿鼻獄，看你如何孟八郎。若說佛法供養大眾，雪上加霜；若說世法供養大眾，擔水河頭賣。總不與麼，刺頭入膠盆，別有機關，也是胡孫伎倆。畢竟如何？衝開碧落松千尺，截斷紅塵水一溪。台州光孝入院，云：機輪轉處，作者猶迷；祖令當行，魔軍膽喪。設使言前薦得，畫餅充飢；句下精通，釘樁搖櫓。何如具大種智，有大信根，豁開心眼，洞徹威音，於一毫端現寶王剎，坐微塵裏轉大法輪，便見山林城市初無兩般，佛法世法打成一片。畢竟是什麼人分上事？莫怪渠儂多意氣，佗家曾踏上頭關。釋迦掩室於摩竭，欲隱彌露；淨名杜口於毗耶，葛藤不少。須菩提喝無說以顯道，巡人犯夜；釋梵絕聽而雨花，隨邪逐惡

Senses.Explanation: A donkey-tethering stake is a post to which a donkey is fastened. Chan speakers call bodhi and nirvana, teaching collections, and fixed formulations donkey-tethering stakes. Boatman Decheng makes the verbal use explicit: “one phrase that fits the head—ten thousand aeons a donkey-tethering stake.” The stake remains the concrete tethering object; Zen bends it into a name for words or teachings at which someone stays tied.

Occurrences.Kwic: 卓一下：葫蘆棚上掛冬瓜，黃檗樹頭懸蜜果。復舉：六祖大師示眾云：吾有一物，無頭、無尾，無名、無字，無背、無面，諸人還識麼？時，荷澤神會出云：是諸佛之本源，乃神會之佛性。祖乃打一棒，云：我喚作一物尚不中，豈況本源佛性？此子向後設有把茆蓋頭，也只成得箇知解宗徒。師云：誰解當陽斬萬機？競將知解亂鍼錐，木人把板雲中拍，石女含笙水底吹。歲旦，立春，謝兩序，上堂。百年難遇歲朝春，便覺乾坤氣象新，海底泥牛鬪折角，峰頭鐵󳬧舞翻身。掌知金穀公廉士，表率叢林道德人，願祝無疆聖人壽
